correctness.rationale: Coefficient extraction gives \(B=[x^{p-1}]F^lF\prime\equiv-T_{l,m}(p)\). In the exceptional case \(l+1=ap\), Frobenius in \(\mathbb F_p[[x]]/(x^p)\) gives \(F^p\equiv1\) and hence \(F^l\equiv F^{-1}\). Factoring \(F=\prod(1-\alpha_i x)\), the required logarithmic-derivative coefficient is \(-\sum\alpha_i^p\); because the coefficient of \(x\) in \(F\) is one, \(\sum\alpha_i=-1\), so Frobenius makes the coefficient exactly one and therefore \(T\equiv-1\). The nonexceptional branch is Sun's derivative argument. A fresh independent exact replay over primes through eleven and a multi-parameter grid reproduced the dichotomy, while the package verifier checks the larger stated grid.
